data.narrative:
Wetstone is a seed-stage company in Climate & Energy founded by Graham Talbot and Sahil Abbi. The valuation universe comprises one public comparable (LNZA) and eight private peers in the sector, including Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, Electric Hydrogen, and Enovix.

Peer-median triangulation is not applicable to this analysis. The Climate & Energy sector contains eight same-sector peers, but filtering for same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-valuation-tier comparables yielded fewer than three datapoints in each narrow category. A seed-stage company lacks sufficient close-peer density to support reliable median benchmarking without introducing misleading distortions from broader sector medians that span vastly different development phases and capital requirements.

No triangulated valuation range can be responsibly derived from the available data. Meaningful valuation support would require either: (i) identification of at least three seed-stage or early-stage peers with disclosed valuations in Climate & Energy, (ii) application of bottom-up methods anchored to company-specific metrics (burn rate, runway, technical de-risking milestones), or (iii) comparable transaction data from recent seed-stage financings in the sector. The current dataset permits only directional positioning: Wetstone operates within a sector containing mature private companies and at least one public exit, but lacks the peer granularity required for quantitative valuation synthesis at the seed stage.
